verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-markdown and search service that can be self-hosted with a bundled headless Chrome, so a real-time dashboard for system metrics and browser/worker pools is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions a metrics dashboard, pool status view, or any monitoring UI. The proxy pool and S3 caching are separate features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monitor live system metrics and worker/browser pool status through a real-time dashboard
